lessons.title: Aşama 1 · Simple Present ve have/has
lessons.goal: Bu aşamanın sonunda alışkanlıkların, genel doğrular ve sahip olduğun şeyler (ağrılar dahil) hakkında olumlu, olumsuz ve soru cümleleri kurabileceksin.

grammar.title: Simple Present: olumlu cümle
grammar.summary: Rutinler, alışkanlıklar, genel doğrular ve sevdiğimiz şeyler için kullanılır. I/You/We/They + V1 → I work. He/She/It + V1-s → She works. Yazım: go → goes, watch → watches, do → does, study → studies; ama play → plays. people çoğuldur → People are / People work.
examples: I work from home.
She works from home.
Water boils at 100 degrees.

grammar.title: Olumsuz ve soru: do / does
grammar.summary: Olumsuz → Özne + don't/doesn't + V1. Soru → Do/Does + özne + V1? does veya doesn't gelince fiildeki -s gider: She works → She doesn't work → Does she work? Kısa cevap: Yes, I do. / No, she doesn't. 'Katılıyorum' gibi fiillerde am/is/are kullanılmaz: I agree.
examples: I don't drink coffee.
Does she work on Sundays?
Do you draw? - Yes, I do.

grammar.title: have / has (sahiplik ve ağrılar)
grammar.summary: I/You/We/They → have / don't have. He/She/It → has / doesn't have (doesn't has değil!). Türkçede 'başım ağrıyor' deriz ama İngilizcede ağrı ve belirtiler için have kullanılır: I have a headache. Dış görünüşte de: She has long hair.
examples: He has a good house.
She doesn't have much free time.
I have a sore throat.

vocab.ex: I have a headache.
I have a toothache, so I need a dentist.
She has a stomachache.
He often has a backache after work.
I have a sore throat.
I have a runny nose and a cough.
My son has a fever.
I have a high temperature.
I have a bad cough.
I keep sneezing.
I have a stiff neck today.
The baby has a rash.
He vomited after dinner.
Take a pill after breakfast.
Apply the ointment to the skin.
Take this cough syrup twice a day.
What are your symptoms?
What treatment do you need?

questions.explain: He/She/It ile Simple Present'ta fiile -s/-es gelir: go → goes.
doesn't geldikten sonra fiil yalın (V1) olur; -s gider.
He/She/It sorularında Does kullanılır. 'Is he work' yanlıştır çünkü cümlede asıl fiil var.
I/you/we/they ile soru: Do + özne + V1? 'Are you exercise' Türkçe düşünmekten gelen bir hatadır.
Sessiz harf + y ile biten fiillerde y → ies: study → studies (ama play → plays).
They ile olumsuz: don't + V1. doesn't sadece he/she/it içindir.
Kısa cevapta soruya ait yardımcı fiil tekrar edilir: Do you...? → Yes, I do.
people çoğuldur (insanlar), bu yüzden are kullanılır.
doesn't'tan sonra fiil yalın kalır: doesn't have. 'doesn't has' çok sık yapılan bir hatadır.
İngilizcede ağrılar için have kullanılır: I have a headache.

questions.q: Boşluğu doldur: He ___ (watch) TV every evening.
questions.explain: -ch ile biten fiillere he/she/it ile -es gelir: watch → watches.
Does başa gelir ve plays → play olur (-s gider).
Dış görünüşte have/has + isim kullanılır. hair sayılamaz, 'hairs' denmez.

mistakes.note: Does zaten 3. tekil eki taşır; fiil yalın kalır.
doesn't'tan sonra fiil her zaman yalın: have.
agree bir fiildir; Türkçedeki 'katılıyorum' yapısı yüzünden am eklenmez.

lessons.title: Aşama 2 · Günlük rutin ve sıklık zarfları
lessons.goal: Bu aşamanın sonunda günlük rutinini ve bir şeyi ne sıklıkla yaptığını doğru kelime sırasıyla anlatabileceksin.

grammar.title: Sıklık zarfları ve yerleri
grammar.summary: always (%100) → usually → normally/often → sometimes → occasionally → rarely/seldom → hardly ever → never (%0). Normal fiil: Özne + zarf + fiil → I usually drink coffee. To be: Özne + am/is/are + zarf → I am usually tired. never zaten olumsuzdur; yanına don't gelmez.
examples: I always eat breakfast.
I sometimes draw at night.
She is always hungry.

grammar.title: How often? ve zaman ifadeleri
grammar.summary: How often do you + V1? → Ne sıklıkla...? Cevaplar: every day, once a week, twice a week, three times a week, on weekends. Dikkat: I don't always play (her zaman oynamam) ≠ I never play (hiç oynamam).
examples: How often do you exercise?
I work out three times a week.
What do you usually do in the morning?

vocab.ex: I wake up at 8.
I get up five minutes later.
I have breakfast at home.
I never skip breakfast.
I start work at 9.
I finish work in the evening.
I usually work from home.
I take a short break every two hours.
I work out three times a week.
I sometimes go out at night.
I usually stay home on Sundays.
I go to bed around midnight.
I spend time drawing in the evening.
I practice English every day.
I occasionally go to the cinema.
I hardly ever watch TV.
I go swimming once a week.
What's new? - Nothing much.
I did nothing special today.
He was late, as usual.

questions.explain: usually + every morning → rutin → Simple Present (V1).
Normal fiilde sıklık zarfı fiilden önce gelir: I always drink.

options: I usually am tired in the evening.
I am usually tired in the evening.
questions.explain: am/is/are varsa sıklık zarfı ondan sonra gelir: I am usually tired.
To be + zarf: They are rarely sad.
How often + do/does + özne + V1? you ile do.
'kez' anlamında times çoğul olur: three times a week. Bir kez = once, iki kez = twice.
never tek başına olumsuz anlam verir; don't ile birlikte kullanılmaz.
don't always = her zaman değil; never = hiç.

questions.q: "I hardly ever watch TV." ne demek?
questions.explain: hardly ever ≈ rarely = neredeyse hiç / nadiren.

questions.q: "I get up five minutes later." cümlesinde get up ne demek?
questions.explain: wake up = gözünü açmak (uyanmak); get up = yataktan kalkmak.

questions.q: Sırala: usually / I / at night / draw
questions.explain: Özne + sıklık zarfı + fiil + zaman ifadesi.

questions.q: Çevir (work out kullan): "Haftada iki kez spor yaparım."
questions.answer: I work out twice a week.
questions.explain: iki kez = twice; zaman ifadesi genelde sona gelir.

questions.q: Soru kur: how often / you / exercise

mistakes.note: Sıklık zarfı normal fiilden önce gelir.
am/is/are varsa zarf ondan sonra gelir.
never zaten olumsuz; İngilizcede çift olumsuz kullanılmaz.

mistakes.wrong: I exercise three time a week.
mistakes.right: I exercise three times a week.
mistakes.note: 'kez' anlamındaki time sayıyla çoğul olur: times.

lessons.title: Aşama 3 · In / On / At (zaman ve yer)
lessons.goal: Bu aşamanın sonunda saat, gün, ay, yıl ve yer bildirirken in, on ve at'i doğru seçebileceksin.

grammar.title: Zaman: at / on / in
grammar.summary: AT → saat ve nokta zamanlar: at 8, at noon, at midnight, at night. ON → günler ve tarihler: on Monday, on weekends, on May 5th, on my birthday. IN → ay, yıl, mevsim, gün bölümleri: in September, in 2026, in summer, in the morning. İstisna: in the morning / in the evening ama at night. Ezber: at 9 → on Monday → in September.
examples: I wake up at 8.
I usually relax on weekends.
I started learning English in 2026.

grammar.title: Yer ve ulaşım
grammar.summary: AT → belirli nokta/konum: at home, at work, at the gym, at the airport. IN → bir alanın içi: in the room, in the car, in Istanbul, in Turkey. ON → yüzey: on the table, on the wall, on the floor. Ulaşım: küçük/özel araç → in the car, in a taxi; toplu taşıma → on the bus, on the train, on the plane.
examples: I am at home.
My phone is on the table.
I'm on the bus.

vocab.ex: We have lunch at noon.
I go to bed at midnight.
I usually draw at night.
I usually stay home on weekends.
I went out for dinner on my birthday.
I work in the morning.
I want to travel more in the future.
I usually relax on weekends.
She is at the airport now.
There is a picture on the wall.
My bag is on the floor.
I'm in a taxi right now.
I read books on the train.

questions.explain: Ülke ve şehirler geniş alandır → in.
İstisna: in the evening ama at night.
Gün bölümleri (morning, afternoon, evening) → in the ...
Toplu taşıma araçlarında on: on the bus / on the train / on the plane.
Araba gibi küçük araçlarda in: in the car, in a taxi.
Sabit kalıp: at home, at work, at school.

questions.q: Boşluğu doldur: My birthday is ___ October.
Boşluğu doldur: There is a picture ___ the wall.
questions.explain: Duvar bir yüzeydir → on the wall.

mistakes.note: in the morning / afternoon / evening; sadece night ile at.

lessons.title: Aşama 4 · Zamirler ve sahiplik (he / him / his)
lessons.goal: Bu aşamanın sonunda bir kişiyi cümledeki görevine göre doğru kelimeyle (he / him / his / his) gösterebileceksin.

grammar.title: Özne ve nesne: he – him
grammar.summary: İşi yapan kişi → özne: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. İş o kişiye yapılıyorsa (fiilden veya with/to/for gibi edattan sonra) → nesne: me, you, him, her, it, us, them. He called me. → I called him. Hafıza: He → Him → His = O → Onu/Ona → Onun.
examples: He invited me.
I called him.
I went with him.

grammar.title: Sahiplik: his car / this car is his
grammar.summary: my / your / his / her / its / our / their + İSİM → my car. mine / yours / his / hers / ours / theirs → isim YOK → The car is mine. her iki görevlidir: I called her (nesne) / her car (sahiplik). its = onun (nesne/hayvan), it's = it is / it has; sahiplikte kesme işareti yoktur.
examples: This is my car. / This car is mine.
Their office is large. / This office is theirs.
The dog is eating its food.

vocab.ex: Whose laptop is this? - It's mine.
They are my colleagues. I work with them.
My workspace is very small.
My desk is next to the window.
I like my computer. Its screen is very big.
The cat is cleaning its paws.
I get along with my colleagues.
You can count on her; she is always there.
I talked to him yesterday.

questions.explain: İsimden (car) önce sahiplik sıfatı: His car (onun arabası).
Arkasında isim yok → possessive pronoun: mine (benim / benimki).
project bir isim → sahiplik sıfatı their.
Sahiplikte its kesme işaretsizdir; it's = it is.
Özne konumunda she kullanılır; her nesne veya sahiplik içindir.

questions.q: Dönüştür: "This is their house." → "This house is ___."

questions.explain: with bir edat; arkasından nesne him gelir.
his hem sıfat hem zamir olabilir; burada isim olmadan kullanılıyor.

mistakes.note: my'dan sonra isim gerekir; isim yoksa mine.
Türkçede 'onu' derken hep nesne halini düşün: him / her / them.

lessons.title: Aşama 5 · Simple Past ve was/were
lessons.goal: Bu aşamanın sonunda dün ve geçmişte olanları olumlu, olumsuz ve soru cümleleriyle anlatabilecek, did ile was/were'i ayırt edebileceksin.

grammar.title: V1 – V2 – V3
grammar.summary: V1 = yalın hal (Simple Present, can/did/will sonrası). V2 = Simple Past olumlu cümle. V3 = have/has + V3 (Present Perfect). Düzenli fiiller -ed alır: work – worked – worked. Düzensizler ezberlenir: go – went – gone, see – saw – seen, eat – ate – eaten, make – made – made, dye – dyed – dyed.
examples: I work every day. (V1)
I worked yesterday. (V2)
I have worked here before. (V3)

grammar.title: Simple Past: V2 ve did
grammar.summary: Olumlu → Özne + V2: I went home. Olumsuz → Özne + didn't + V1. Soru → Did + özne + V1? did/didn't geçmişi zaten gösterir, fiil V1 kalır: I didn't went ❌ → I didn't go ✅. Zaman ifadeleri: yesterday, last night, last week, two days ago, in 2025.
examples: I went to the gym yesterday.
I didn't go out.
Did you call him?

grammar.title: Was / Were — did mi, was mı?
grammar.summary: am/is → was, are → were. I/he/she/it → was; you/we/they → were. Olumsuz: wasn't / weren't. Cümlede asıl fiil varsa did: Where did you go? (Nereye gittin?). Fiil yoksa (sıfat, yer) was/were: Where were you? (Neredeydin?)
examples: I was tired last night.
They weren't at home.
Were you busy?

grammar.title: Hayatın bir dönemi: when I was a child
grammar.summary: Türkçede 'çocukken, gençken' tek kelime; İngilizcede when + özne + was/were + isim/sıfat kurulur. İngilizce cümlede fiil şarttır: When I child ❌ → When I was a child ✅. Aynı kalıp: when I was young, when I was at school, when I was ten. Cümlenin başında da sonunda da olabilir; başta ise virgül konur: When I was a child, I lived in Izmir.
examples: When I was a child, I lived in a small town.
I loved cartoons when I was a child.
When we were kids, we played outside every day.
When I was ten, I broke my arm.

vocab.ex: I bought a new dress on a whim.

vocab.en: on the spur of the moment
vocab.ex: We went out for dinner on the spur of the moment.
I dyed my hair yesterday.
Her name slipped my mind.
We decided to go on a road trip on a whim.
We went out for dinner last night.
I started this job two years ago.
I went home early.
I saw my friend yesterday.
I wrote an email to my boss.
I took a taxi.
I found my keys.
I felt tired after work.
I knew the answer.
When I was a child, I was very shy.
I had a happy childhood.

questions.explain: yesterday → Simple Past, olumlu cümlede V2: saw.
didn't geçmişi zaten gösterir; fiil V1: go.

questions.q: I ___ my hair on a whim.
questions.explain: dye – dyed = boyamak; die – died = ölmek. Telaffuzları aynı, yazılışları farklı.

questions.q: "On the spur of the moment" ne demek?
questions.explain: Plansız, o anın etkisiyle verilen karar.
Kalıp: slip someone's mind = aklından çıkmak.

questions.q: Boşluğu doldur: They ___ (be) at home last night.
Soru cümlesi yap: "You went to the gym yesterday."
questions.answer: Did you go to the gym yesterday?
questions.explain: Did başa gelir, went → go olur.

options: When I child, I was very shy.
When I was a child, I was very shy.
When I were a child, I was very shy.
questions.explain: when + I + was + a child. Fiil (was) atlanmaz; I ile were değil was.

questions.q: When we ___ kids, we played outside every day.
Boşluğu doldur: When I ___ ten, I broke my arm.
questions.explain: Yaş da be ile söylenir: I was ten.

questions.answer: When I was a child, I lived in Izmir.
accept: When I was a child, I lived in İzmir.
I lived in Izmir when I was a child.
I lived in İzmir when I was a child.
When I was a kid, I lived in Izmir.
When I was a kid, I lived in İzmir.
questions.explain: when I was a child + Simple Past.

questions.q: Sırala: loved / I / cartoons / when / was / I / a child
questions.answer: I loved cartoons when I was a child
accept: When I was a child I loved cartoons
questions.explain: Ana cümle + when + özne + was + a child.

mistakes.wrong: I didn't went to the gym.
mistakes.right: I didn't go to the gym.

mistakes.wrong: Were you go out last night?
mistakes.right: Did you go out last night?
mistakes.note: Asıl fiil varsa soru did ile kurulur.
Geçmişte fiil için was eklenmez; fiilin V2'si kullanılır.

mistakes.wrong: When I child, I lived in a village.
mistakes.right: When I was a child, I lived in a village.
mistakes.note: 'Çocukken' = when I was a child. İngilizce cümlede fiil şart; was atlanmaz.

lessons.title: Aşama 6 · Doğum ve ölüm: be born, die / dead / death
lessons.goal: Bu aşamanın sonunda nerede ve ne zaman doğduğunu anlatabilecek, die / died / dead / death kelimelerini cümlede doğru yerde kullanabileceksin.

grammar.title: be born: doğmak
grammar.summary: İngilizcede 'doğmak' tek bir fiil değil, be born kalıbıdır. Doğum geçmişte olduğu için was/were born kullanılır: I was born in 1996. I born ❌, I am born in 1996 ❌. Soru da was/were ile kurulur: Where were you born? (Where did you born ❌). Edatlar: in + yıl/ay/şehir/ülke (in 1996, in May, in Istanbul), on + tam tarih (on 5 May 1996).
examples: I was born in 1996.
She was born in Istanbul.
When were you born?
My son was born on 3 March.

grammar.title: birth / birthday / give birth
grammar.summary: birth = doğum (isim): date of birth (doğum tarihi), place of birth (doğum yeri). birthday = doğum günü (her yıl kutlanan gün). give birth to + bebek = doğum yapmak: She gave birth to a baby girl. Bebek doğar → was born; anne doğum yapar → gave birth.
examples: Please write your date of birth.
Today is my birthday.
She gave birth to twins last week.
Their baby was born yesterday.

grammar.title: die / died / dead / death
grammar.summary: die = ölmek (fiil): die – died – died, -ing hali dying. dead = ölü, hayatta değil (sıfat) → be ile kullanılır: He is dead. death = ölüm (isim): His death was a shock. Türkçedeki 'öldü' iki şekilde çevrilir: olay ve zaman → He died last year. Şu anki durum → He is dead (hayatta değil). He is died ❌. die of + hastalık/açlık (die of cancer), die from + yara/dış sebep (die from his injuries). Kibar söyleyiş: pass away. dye (boyamak) ile karıştırma: I dyed my hair.
examples: He died last year.
My grandfather is dead.
His death was unexpected.
She died of cancer.

vocab.ex: I was born in 1996.
The birth of their first child changed everything.
What did you do on your last birthday?
Please write your name and date of birth.
She gave birth to a baby girl.
He died last year.
My grandfather is dead.
His death was unexpected.
She died of cancer. He died from his injuries.
My grandmother passed away two years ago.
Is your grandfather still alive?
I was born in Ankara, but I grew up in Izmir.
My hometown is a small city by the sea.

questions.explain: Doğmak = be born. Doğum geçmişte olduğu için was born.
be born kalıbı was/were ile soru yapar: Where were you born? did kullanılmaz.
Şehir ve yıl için in: in Istanbul, in 1996.
Olay ve zaman (last year) → fiil: died.
be + sıfat: is dead (hayatta değil). is died denmez.

questions.q: His ___ was a big shock for us.

questions.explain: Belli bir geçmiş zaman (last year) varsa Simple Past: died.

questions.q: She gave ___ to a baby boy.

questions.explain: Her yıl kutlanan doğum günü: birthday.
be + alive = hayatta olmak. live fiil, life isim.

questions.q: "Vefat etmek" anlamına gelen kibar ifade hangisi?
questions.explain: pass away = vefat etmek. pass out = bayılmak.

questions.q: Boşluğu doldur: She ___ (be born) in Ankara.

accept: My grandfather is not alive.
My grandfather isn't alive.
My grandpa is dead.
My grandfather has died.
questions.explain: Şu anki durum → be + dead (veya not alive).
die – died – died. dyed (boyadı) ile karıştırma.

questions.q: Sırala: grew up / I / in Izmir / was born / but / in Ankara / I
questions.answer: I was born in Ankara but I grew up in Izmir
accept: I was born in Izmir but I grew up in Ankara
questions.explain: be born = doğmak, grow up = büyümek.

mistakes.note: Doğmak = be born. Geçmişte olduğu için was gerekir; born tek başına fiil değildir.
be born kalıbında soru was/were ile kurulur, did ile değil.
dead sıfattır (be + dead). Olay anlatılıyorsa sadece He died. kullanılır.
His'ten sonra isim gelir: death (ölüm). dead sıfattır.

lessons.title: Aşama 7 · Used to ve regret
lessons.goal: Bu aşamanın sonunda eskiden yapıp artık yapmadığın şeyleri ve pişmanlıklarını anlatabileceksin.

grammar.title: used to + V1 (eskiden ...rdım)
grammar.summary: Geçmişte düzenli olan ama artık olmayan alışkanlık ve durumlar. Olumlu → used to + V1. Olumsuz → didn't use to + V1. Soru → Did + özne + use to + V1? Olumsuz ve soruda did olduğu için -d düşer: use to. Kalıp: I used to ..., but now I ... Dikkat: be used to (bir şeye alışkın olmak) farklı bir yapıdır.
examples: I used to play games every night.
I didn't use to exercise.
Did you use to draw a lot?

grammar.title: regret + V-ing
grammar.summary: regret + V-ing → yaptığım için pişmanım. regret + not + V-ing → yapmadığım için pişmanım. Bu anlamda regret to + V1 kullanılmaz. Present Perfect ile: Have you ever regretted + V-ing?
examples: I regret wasting too much time.
I regret not studying English earlier.
Have you ever regretted taking a risk?

vocab.ex: I used to waste a lot of time.
I regret not taking that opportunity.
I regret not studying English earlier.
I regret not improving my English earlier.
Did you use to exercise regularly?
I used to play football when I was younger.

vocab.en: I used to ..., but now I ...
vocab.ex: I used to work in an office, but now I work from home.
I used to drink a lot of coffee.

questions.q: I used to ___ games every night.

questions.explain: didn't varsa -d düşer: didn't use to.

questions.q: ___ you use to draw a lot?
questions.explain: Soru: Did + özne + use to + V1?
Yapmadığın şeye pişmanlık: regret + not + V-ing.

questions.q: "I used to drink a lot of coffee." ne demek?
questions.explain: used to + V1 = eskiden ...rdım (artık değil). 'Alışkınım' be used to + V-ing olur.

questions.q: He ___ to play football, but now he doesn't.

options: I didn't use to exercise, but now I do.
I don't used to exercise, but now I do.
I used to not exercising, but now I do.

questions.q: Boşluğu doldur: I used to ___ (feel) nervous when I spoke English.
Boşluğu doldur: I regret ___ (waste) too much time.
Sırala: used to / coffee / drink / I / a lot of
questions.answer: I used to drink a lot of coffee

mistakes.wrong: I am used to play games every night.
mistakes.right: I used to play games every night.
mistakes.note: 'Eskiden oynardım' için am eklenmez. be used to = alışkın olmak, farklı yapı.

mistakes.wrong: I regret to waste my time.

lessons.title: Aşama 8 · Gelecek: will, going to ve First Conditional
lessons.goal: Bu aşamanın sonunda planlarını, anlık kararlarını, tahminlerini ve 'eğer ... olursa' cümlelerini kurabileceksin.

grammar.title: will / be going to
grammar.summary: will + V1 → o anda verilen karar, tahmin, söz/teklif: I'm tired. I will go home. Olumsuz: won't (will not). am/is/are + going to + V1 → önceden plan/niyet: I'm going to study tonight. Soru: Will you ...? / Are you going to ...? will'den sonra can gelmez → will be able to.
examples: I will help you.
I think it will rain tomorrow.
I am going to study English tonight.

grammar.title: Tahmin kalıpları
grammar.summary: There's a good chance that + özne + will + V1 → büyük ihtimalle (güçlü ihtimal). It's possible that ... → olabilir (sadece mümkün). It's possible that she's busy right now. Geçmiş için: It's possible that he forgot.
examples: There's a good chance that the exam will be hard.
It's possible that it will rain tomorrow.
It's possible that he forgot about the meeting.

grammar.title: First Conditional: If + present, will + V1
grammar.summary: Gerçekleşmesi mümkün gelecek durumlar: If + Simple Present, will + V1. If tarafında will kullanılmaz: If it will rain ❌ → If it rains ✅. Sıra değişebilir: I will stay home if it rains. (If başta ise virgül konur.) Gerçekçi olmayan hayaller (1 milyon dolarım olsa) için başka yapı kullanılır: If I had..., I would... (ileride).
examples: If it rains, I will stay home.
If it snows tomorrow, I will wear warm clothes.
What will you do if you can't sleep tonight?

vocab.ex: There's a good chance that my father will find it.
It's possible that she's busy right now.
I will call you later.
I'm going to start a new project soon.
What are you going to do this weekend?

vocab.tr: iki gün içinde / iki gün sonra
vocab.ex: I will finish it in two days.
I'm hungry. I will order food.
I want to travel around the world one day.
If it snows, I will wear warm clothes.
Will you bring an umbrella if it rains?
If your TV breaks next week, what will you do?
If I have nothing to do tomorrow, I will go to the beach.

questions.q: "I'm hungry. I ___ order food." (karar şimdi verildi)
"I bought the tickets. I ___ travel next week."
questions.explain: Bilet alınmış, önceden plan var → going to.
going to sorusu: Am/Is/Are + özne + going to + V1?

questions.q: There's a good chance that she ___ later.
questions.explain: Gelecek tahmini: that + özne + will + V1.

questions.q: It's ___ that he forgot about the meeting.
If it ___ tomorrow, I will stay home.
questions.explain: If tarafında Simple Present kullanılır, will değil.

questions.q: If I have free time tomorrow, I ___ to the gym.
Boşluğu doldur: If he ___ (study) hard, he will pass the test.
questions.explain: If + Simple Present; he ile study → studies.

questions.q: Çevir (If ile başla, will'i kısaltma): "Eğer yarın yağmur yağarsa evde kalacağım."
questions.answer: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.

mistakes.wrong: If it will rain, I will stay home.
mistakes.right: If it rains, I will stay home.

mistakes.wrong: I am going to studying tonight.
mistakes.right: I am going to study tonight.
I am going to study tonight.

mistakes.wrong: If I have $1 million, I will travel around the world.
mistakes.right: If I had $1 million, I would travel around the world.
mistakes.note: Gerçekçi olmayan hayal için First Conditional uygun değil; If + V2, would + V1 kullanılır (Second Conditional).

lessons.title: Aşama 9 · Yetenekler: can, be able to, good at
lessons.goal: Bu aşamanın sonunda neler yapabildiğini, neyde iyi olduğunu ve gelecekte neyi yapabileceğini anlatabileceksin.

grammar.title: can / can't / be able to
grammar.summary: can + V1 → yapabilmek: I can draw. Olumsuz: can't + V1. Soru: Can + özne + V1? can'den sonra to veya -ing gelmez. be able to + V1 → am/is/are able to (I able to ❌). Gelecekte will can denmez → will be able to + V1.
examples: I can use Blender.
I can't speak English fluently yet.
I will be able to speak English better.

grammar.title: good at / talent for / also
grammar.summary: be good at + isim/V-ing → bir konuda iyi olmak. have a talent for + isim/V-ing → yetenekli olmak. I can draw (çizebilirim) / I am good at drawing (çizimde iyiyim) / I have a talent for drawing (yeteneğim var). also: normal fiilden önce (I also draw), can ve am/is/are'den sonra (I can also paint / I am also interested).
examples: I am good at sculpting.
I have a talent for character design.
I can also paint.

grammar.title: could / couldn't: geçmişte yapabilmek
grammar.summary: could, can'in geçmiş halidir. could / couldn't + V1 (yalın fiil). Yardımcı fiilden sonra fiil asla V2 olmaz: I couldn't slept ❌ → I couldn't sleep ✅. didn't could da denmez. Soru: Could you swim when you were a child? Tek seferlik bir başarı için olumlu cümlede was able to / managed to daha doğaldır: I was able to finish on time. Olumsuzda couldn't her zaman doğru. Not: Could you help me? = kibar rica (Bana yardım edebilir misin?).
examples: I couldn't sleep last night.
I could read when I was five.
Could you swim when you were a child?
She couldn't find her keys.

vocab.ex: I can draw very well.
She is good at painting.
I am good at sculpting.
I have a talent for character design.
I am good at 3D modeling.
I can create 3D characters.
I can't speak English fluently yet.
I am able to work independently.
They are able to work remotely.
Can she swim? - Yes, she can.

vocab.en: I'm not very good at ... yet, but I'm improving.
vocab.tr: Henüz ... konusunda çok iyi değilim ama gelişiyorum.
vocab.ex: I'm not very good at English yet, but I'm improving.
I couldn't sleep last night.
I couldn't fall asleep until 3 a.m.

questions.explain: at bir edat; edattan sonra fiil -ing alır.

questions.q: I ___ speak English better next year.
questions.explain: İki modal yan yana gelmez; gelecekte will be able to.

options: I am also interested in painting.
I also am interested in painting.
questions.explain: am/is/are varsa also ondan sonra gelir.
be able to: She is able to.

questions.q: I have a talent ___ character design.

questions.explain: Kalıp: be good at (Türkçedeki '-de iyi' yüzünden in seçmek sık hata).
Cevap 'Yes, I can' ise soru da Can ile kurulur.

questions.q: Çevir (I am ile başla): "3D modellemede iyiyim."
Boşluğu doldur: I am good at ___ (sculpt).
I ___ swim when I was five. I learned at ten.
questions.explain: Geçmişte yapamamak → couldn't + V1. didn't could denmez.

options: I didn't could go to work.

questions.q: ___ you speak English when you were a child?
questions.explain: Geçmişteki yetenek sorusu: Could + özne + V1?

accept: I could not sleep last night.
Last night I couldn't sleep.
Last night I could not sleep.

questions.q: Boşluğu doldur: She couldn't ___ (find) her keys.
Sırala: couldn't / I / the answer / remember

mistakes.right: I will be able to speak better.
mistakes.note: will ve can yan yana gelmez.
be able to'da be fiili (am/is/are) şart.
could/couldn't bir yardımcı fiildir; ondan sonra fiil yalın (V1) gelir.

lessons.title: Aşama 10 · Duygular, -ed/-ing ve korkular
lessons.goal: Bu aşamanın sonunda duygularını ve korkularını doğru sıfat ve edatlarla anlatabileceksin.

grammar.title: -ed / -ing sıfatlar
grammar.summary: -ed → duyguyu hisseden kişi: I am bored. -ing → o duyguyu yaratan şey: The lesson is boring. Çiftler: interested/interesting, excited/exciting, tired/tiring, confused/confusing, embarrassed/embarrassing, frustrated/frustrating. Her -ing şimdiki zaman değildir; cümlenin tamamına bak.
examples: I am interested in art. / Art is interesting.
I am excited. / The trip is exciting.
This game is interesting.

grammar.title: Duygu + edat
grammar.summary: interested in, excited about, nervous about, scared of, afraid of, jealous of, looking forward to. Edattan sonra fiil -ing alır: I'm afraid of making mistakes. looking forward to'daki to bir edattır → looking forward to meeting you. Türkçedeki '-den korkmak' yüzünden from kullanılmaz: afraid of.
examples: I am nervous about the meeting.
I am scared of spiders.
I am looking forward to the weekend.

grammar.title: Korkudan bahsetmek
grammar.summary: I get scared when + cümle. The thing I'm most afraid of is ... I used to be afraid of ..., but now ... Even though I'm scared, I ... Deyimler: freak out (paniklemek), chicken out (korkup vazgeçmek), give someone the creeps (ürpertmek).
examples: I get scared when I hear strange noises.
I used to be afraid of the dark, but now I'm fine.
I wanted to try it, but I chickened out.

grammar.title: afraid bir sıfat: be + afraid
grammar.summary: afraid, scared, tired, sure, ready gibi sıfatlarla do/does kullanılmaz; be fiili (am/is/are, was/were) kullanılır. Olumsuz: I'm not afraid. (I don't afraid ❌) Soru: Are you afraid of dogs? (Do you afraid ❌) Geçmiş: I wasn't afraid. Kural: sıfat → am/is/are + not; fiil → don't/doesn't + V1 (I don't like spiders).
examples: I'm not afraid of the dark.
Are you afraid of heights?
She isn't scared at all.
I wasn't afraid.

vocab.ex: I feel frustrated when my computer is slow.
I was embarrassed in front of everyone.
This rule is confusing.
She was heartbroken after the news.
I am thrilled about the new job.
I am looking forward to meeting you.
I freaked out when I saw the spider.
I wanted to try it, but I chickened out.
Old houses give me the creeps.
That story gave me the chills.
I was scared stiff.
You made me jump out of my skin!
I have butterflies in my stomach before interviews.
I was shaking with fear.
I try to stay calm.
You need to face your fears.
She wants to get over her fear of flying.
That noise was really freaky.
He has claustrophobia, so he never uses the lift.
Acrophobia is the fear of heights.
I'm not afraid of the dark.

questions.explain: Film sıkıcı (duyguyu yaratan) → boring. 'The movie is bored' = film sıkılmış.

questions.q: I am looking forward to ___ you.
questions.explain: look forward to'daki to edattır → V-ing.
Türkçede '-den korkmak' ama İngilizcede scared of / afraid of.

questions.q: I wanted to try bungee jumping, but I ___.
questions.explain: chicken out = korkup son anda vazgeçmek.
claustrophobia = kapalı alan; acrophobia = yükseklik; nyctophobia = karanlık.

questions.answer: I used to be afraid of dogs.

questions.explain: afraid sıfattır → be + not: I'm not afraid.

questions.answer: I'm not afraid of the dark.

I am not afraid.
I'm not scared.
I am not scared.
Are you scared of dogs?

mistakes.right: I am looking forward to meeting you.

lessons.title: Aşama 11 · Present Perfect
lessons.goal: Bu aşamanın sonunda hayat tecrübelerini anlatabilecek ve Simple Past ile Present Perfect arasında doğru seçim yapabileceksin.

grammar.title: have / has + V3
grammar.summary: I/You/We/They + have + V3; He/She/It + has + V3. Olumsuz: haven't/hasn't + V3. Soru: Have/Has + özne + V3? Kullanım: 1) hayat tecrübesi (Have you ever been to Japan?), 2) zamanı belirsiz geçmiş (I have finished my work.), 3) etkisi şimdi süren olay (I have lost my keys.).
examples: I have finished my work.
She hasn't called me.
Have you seen this movie?

grammar.title: ever / never / just / already / yet / before
grammar.summary: ever = hiç (soruda), never = hiç/asla (olumlu fiille), just = az önce, already = çoktan/zaten, yet = henüz (olumsuz ve soruda, cümle sonunda), before = daha önce. been to = gidip gelmiş; gone to = gitmiş, hâlâ orada.
examples: I have never tried sushi.
I have just finished.
I haven't finished yet.

grammar.title: Simple Past mı, Present Perfect mi?
grammar.summary: Zaman belli (yesterday, last week, two days ago, in 2025) → Simple Past: I saw it yesterday. Zaman önemsiz veya şimdiyle bağlantılı → Present Perfect: I have seen it before. Belli zaman ifadesiyle Present Perfect kullanılmaz: I have seen him yesterday ❌.
examples: I went to Italy in 2025.
I have been to Italy.
I have been to the gym three times this week.

vocab.ex: Have you ever tried sushi?
Have you ever tried an extreme sport?
I have never tried skydiving.
Bungee jumping looks scary.
I have lost my keys.
Has she arrived?
I have been to Italy twice.
I have just finished my work.
I have already eaten.
I haven't finished yet.
I have met his family before.

questions.explain: Gidip gelme tecrübesi: have been to.
yesterday ve ago Simple Past ile kullanılır; just Present Perfect ile.
yesterday belli bir zaman → Simple Past.

questions.q: Çevir (I have ile başla): "Hiç Japonya'ya gitmedim."
questions.answer: I have never been to Japan.

questions.q: Sırala: ever / Have / been / you / Italy / to
questions.answer: Have you ever been to Italy?

mistakes.wrong: I have saw this movie before.
mistakes.right: I have seen this movie before.
mistakes.note: have'den sonra V3 gelir, V2 değil.

mistakes.wrong: Did you ever been to Japan?
mistakes.right: Have you ever been to Japan?
mistakes.note: Tecrübe sorusu Have + V3 ile kurulur.

lessons.title: Aşama 12 · Karşılaştırma ve kişileri tanımlama
lessons.goal: Bu aşamanın sonunda insanları ve şeyleri tanımlayıp karşılaştırabilecek, 'en ...' cümleleri kurabileceksin.

grammar.title: Comparative: -er / more ... than
grammar.summary: İki şey karşılaştırılır. Kısa sıfat + -er + than: taller than. Uzun sıfat → more + sıfat + than: more expensive than. Yazım: big → bigger, happy → happier, nice → nicer, scary → scarier. Düzensiz: good → better, bad → worse, far → farther/further. -er ile more birlikte kullanılmaz (more taller ❌). much / a lot / a bit + comparative.
examples: A plane is faster than a car.
This phone is more expensive than mine.
English is easier than I expected.

grammar.title: Superlative ve as ... as
grammar.summary: Grup içinde 'en': the + sıfat-est (the tallest), the most + uzun sıfat (the most important). good → the best, bad → the worst. the'yi unutma. Kalıp: the ...-est ... I have ever seen. Eşitlik: as + sıfat + as; eşit değil: not as + sıfat + as.
examples: He is the tallest in the class.
This is the scariest movie I've ever seen.
My phone is not as expensive as his.

grammar.title: Görünüş ve kişilik
grammar.summary: Görünüş: be + sıfat (He is tall. She is slim.) veya have/has + isim (She has long hair. He has dark hair.). Kişilik: She is talkative / reliable / patient. Kalıplar: A good teacher should be ... / For me, a good teacher is someone who ...
examples: He is tall and he has dark hair.
A good teacher should be patient.
For me, a good teacher is someone who explains things clearly.

grammar.title: reliable, count on ve determined to
grammar.summary: reliable = güvenilir: She's very reliable. You can count on her. (count on someone = birine güvenmek, bel bağlamak; trust on ❌, trust someone ✅). determined = kararlı, azimli. be determined to + V1 = bir şeyi yapmaya kararlı olmak: I'm determined to succeed. to'dan sonra V1 gelir (determined to succeeding ❌). succeed = başarmak (fiil), success = başarı (isim), successful = başarılı (sıfat).
examples: She's very reliable. You can count on her.
I'm determined to succeed.
I'm determined to achieve my goals.
He is determined to learn English this year.

vocab.ex: She is very talkative.
You can count on her; she is reliable.
My old phone is unreliable.
He is always honest with me.
She is quiet in class.
He is athletic and plays basketball.
A good teacher should be patient.
My brother is more ambitious than me.
She is shy and timid around strangers.
Don't call him a coward.
I'm jealous of you.
Your time is valuable.
The ending was predictable.
That movie is scary.
She is tall and slim.
A good teacher explains things clearly.
I like teachers who make a class fun.
She is determined; she never gives up.
I'm determined to succeed.
I'm determined to achieve my goals.

questions.q: This is ___ phone in the shop.
questions.explain: Dükkândaki tüm telefonlar arasında → superlative: the most expensive.

questions.q: My laptop is as ___ as yours.

questions.answer: This car is faster than mine.

You can ___ her. She's very reliable.

I'm determined to be successful.
I am determined to be successful.

Sırala: on / her / count / you / can

determined to + V1; to'dan sonra -ing gelmez.

lessons.title: Aşama 13 · Fiil kalıpları ve collocation'lar
lessons.goal: Bu aşamanın sonunda fiilleri doğru yapıyla (to + V1, V-ing, edat) kullanabilecek ve Türkçeden kelime kelime çeviri hatalarını önleyebileceksin.

grammar.title: Fiil + to V1 / V-ing
grammar.summary: to + V1 alanlar: afford to, manage to, refuse to, offer to, expect to, remind someone to. V-ing alanlar: spend time + V-ing, consider + V-ing, regret + V-ing. Edattan sonra her zaman V-ing: There's no point in + V-ing. Tercih: I'd rather + V1 + than + V1.
examples: I managed to finish on time.
I spend time drawing.
There's no point in waiting if he isn't coming.

grammar.title: Fiil + edat
grammar.summary: complain about sth / complain to sb about sth, agree with sb, depend on, invite sb to, save money for sth, spend money on sth. mention ve discuss doğrudan nesne alır: mention it (mention about ❌). wonder + if / where / who ...
examples: She complained to her boss about the salary.
She invited me to her party.
I wonder where she is.

grammar.title: Doğal eşleşmeler: make / have / miss / take / get
grammar.summary: Türkçeden kelime kelime çevirme! make a mistake (do ❌), have a dream (rüya görmek ≠ see a dream), miss the bus (otobüsü kaçırmak ≠ lose), take a test / a photo / a day off / part in, get a job / a message / permission. many + sayılabilen çoğul (many people), much + sayılamayan (much time).
examples: He made a mistake.
I had a strange dream last night.
I need to get permission first.

lessons.title: Aşama 14 · Risk ve fikir belirtme
lessons.goal: Bu aşamanın sonunda risk alma hakkında konuşup fikrini gerekçeleriyle ifade edebileceksin.

grammar.title: Risk kalıpları
grammar.summary: take a risk (take – took – taken), at risk (of + V-ing), run the risk of + V-ing, worth the risk / worth taking, play it safe, risk it all. Önceki konularla: Have you ever taken a big risk? / Have you ever regretted taking a risk? Would you consider + V-ing? (consider to ❌)
examples: Sometimes you have to take a risk.
You run the risk of losing money.
Would you consider moving to another country?

grammar.title: Fikir belirtme
grammar.summary: In my opinion, ... / I think ... because ... / Olumsuz fikirde olumsuzluk think'e gelir: I don't think + olumlu cümle. It depends on the situation. It largely depends on + isim / wh-cümlesi. It's not so much that ..., it's more that ... (Mesele ... değil, daha çok ...). For example, ...
examples: In my opinion, some risks are worth taking.
I don't think they should have homework every day.
It's not so much that I'm tired; it's more that I'm stressed.

lessons.title: Aşama 15 · Stres, başa çıkma ve zihin
lessons.goal: Bu aşamanın sonunda stresini, zor dönemlerini ve zihninin durumunu doğal ifadelerle anlatabileceksin.

grammar.title: suffer from / cope with / under stress
grammar.summary: suffer from + hastalık/sorun → muzdarip olmak: He suffers from back pain. cope with + zorluk → başa çıkmak: I don't know how to cope with stress. under stress → stres altında; under pressure → baskı altında (iş yükü, son tarih). I'm stressed out. = Çok stresliyim.
examples: Many people suffer from stress.
She finds it difficult to cope with pressure.
I make more mistakes when I'm under stress.

grammar.title: reduce / relieve
grammar.summary: reduce → miktarı azaltmak: reduce stress, costs, spending, waste, the risk. relieve → ağrı, stres, kaygıyı hafifletmek: relieve pain, anxiety, tension. relief = rahatlama, relieved = rahatlamış. What a relief! = Oh, ne rahatladım!
examples: Exercise helps reduce stress.
This medicine can relieve pain.
I was relieved when I heard the news.

grammar.title: Karışan kelimeler: emigrate / immigrate, blank / blanket, messy
grammar.summary: emigrate from → çıkılan ülke; immigrate to → yerleşilen ülke; migrate → genel göç (kuşlar da). blank = boş: My mind went blank. blanket = battaniye; wet blanket = keyif kaçıran kişi. mess (dağınıklık), messy (dağınık), mess up (berbat etmek); organize (düzenlemek), organized / disorganized.
examples: She emigrated from Iran and immigrated to Germany.
My mind went blank during the exam.
Don't be such a wet blanket!

vocab.ex: He suffers from back pain.
He's learning to cope with disappointment.
I can't think clearly when I'm under stress.
I work better under pressure.
I'm stressed out this week.
I want to reduce my spending.
Talking to someone can relieve anxiety.
The test was easy. What a relief!
If you don't study, you will suffer the consequences.
He wants to immigrate to Germany.
She emigrated from Iran.
I went through a difficult period last year.
Don't worry, it's just a phase.
My desk is always messy.
I messed up the presentation.
I need a minute to organize my thoughts.
My mind went blank during the meeting.
I tried to remember his name, but I drew a blank.
He's always a wet blanket at parties.
He has a strong desire to improve.

questions.q: I don't know how to ___ with stress.
I can't think clearly when I'm ___ stress.

questions.explain: reduce stress = stresi azaltmak. cope ise with alır.

questions.q: She emigrated ___ Iran and immigrated ___ Germany.
questions.explain: emigrate from (çıkılan yer), immigrate to (gidilen yer).

questions.q: My room is very ___. I need to organize it.
Çevir (need to kullan): "Stresle başa çıkmam gerekiyor."
questions.answer: I need to cope with stress.

questions.q: Boşluğu doldur (organize / suffer): I need to ___ my time better.

questions.answer: I want to reduce my spending.

mistakes.note: cope her zaman with ile kullanılır.
Ayrılınan ülke için emigrate from; gidilen ülke için immigrate to.

stories.title: Leo and the Blue Door
pages: Leo was ten years old, and he was [[curious|meraklı]] about everything. Why is the sky blue? Where do birds sleep? He asked a hundred questions every day. His grandmother always smiled and said, “Curious minds find [[hidden|gizli, saklı]] doors.” Leo didn't understand her. Not yet.

One rainy afternoon, he was [[alone|yalnız, tek başına]] in her old house. Suddenly, he heard a [[strange|garip, tuhaf]] [[noise|ses, gürültü]] behind the big clock in the hall. Tick, tock… knock, knock! Leo was a little afraid, but he wanted to know more. He [[pushed|itti]] the clock, and it moved. Behind it, there was a small blue door.

Leo opened the door and [[stepped|adım attı]] inside. He [[couldn't believe his eyes|gözlerine inanamadı]]. The trees were purple, the rivers were made of light, and tiny fish were [[floating|süzülüyordu]] in the air. A talking fox [[appeared|belirdi, ortaya çıktı]] and said, “Welcome, [[explorer|kâşif]]! Nobody has visited this world for fifty years.”

The fox showed him [[amazing|inanılmaz, harika]] places: a mountain that sang and a library with books that could talk. Leo asked questions all day, and every question opened a new door. When the clock [[struck|(saat) çaldı, vurdu]] eight, he ran home. “Grandma,” he [[whispered|fısıldadı]], “you were right.” She [[winked|göz kırptı]]. “I know. I found that door when I was a child, too.”

questions.q: Why did Leo ask so many questions?
options: Because he was curious about everything
Because he was bored at school
Because his teacher asked him to
questions.explain: Hikayenin ilk cümlesi: he was curious about everything.

questions.q: Where was the small blue door?
questions.explain: “Behind it (the clock), there was a small blue door.”

questions.q: What was strange in the new world?
options: The trees were purple and fish were floating in the air
questions.explain: The trees were purple… tiny fish were floating in the air.

questions.q: Doğru mu yanlış mı? “Leo's grandmother had never seen the blue door.”
questions.explain: Yanlış. “I found that door when I was a child, too.” Büyükannesi de çocukken bulmuş.
could'nın olumsuzu: couldn't + fiilin yalın hâli. “didn't could” yanlış.

questions.q: Sırala: Leo / pushed / the / big / clock
questions.explain: Özne + V2 + nesne: Leo pushed the big clock.

questions.q: Boşluğu yaz (visit, Present Perfect): “Nobody ___ this world for fifty years.”
questions.explain: for + süre → Present Perfect: Nobody has visited… (Nobody tekil sayılır → has).

stories.title: Mira and the Grey Town
stories.titleTr: Renkleri gören Mira ve gri kasaba
pages: In the town of Greyford, everything was grey: the houses, the sky, the flowers, even people's clothes. Nobody [[noticed|fark etti]] it, because they [[had never seen|hiç görmemişlerdi]] anything different. But Mira was special. When she looked at an apple, she saw red. When she looked at the sea, she saw blue.

She told her friends, “The sky is blue! The grass is green!” They [[laughed at|(alay ederek) güldüler]] her. “You're [[imagining|hayal ediyorsun]] things,” they said. Mira felt sad and [[lonely|yalnız, kimsesiz]]. But one night, she found an old box of paints in the [[attic|çatı katı]]. The colors inside were [[bright|parlak, canlı]] and alive.

The next morning, Mira [[decided|karar verdi]] to show everyone what she could see. She painted a yellow sun on the school wall and red flowers on the old bridge. People stopped and [[stared|dik dik baktı]]. An old man touched the flowers and started to cry. “I remember this color,” he said. “I used to see it when I was young.”

[[Day by day|Günden güne]], the town changed. Children painted their doors, and the baker [[decorated|süsledi]] his shop with orange and pink. Soon, everyone could see colors again. The [[mayor|belediye başkanı]] gave Mira a small [[medal|madalya]] and asked, “How did you do it?” Mira smiled. “I didn't [[create|yaratmak, oluşturmak]] the colors. They were always here. I just helped you see them.”

questions.q: Why didn't the people of Greyford notice the grey?
options: Because they had never seen anything different
questions.explain: Nobody noticed it, because they had never seen anything different.

questions.q: What did Mira find in the attic?
questions.explain: She found an old box of paints in the attic.

questions.q: Why did the old man cry?
options: He remembered a color from his youth
The paint was on his clothes
questions.explain: “I used to see it when I was young.”

questions.q: Doğru mu yanlış mı? “Mira created the colors.”
questions.explain: Yanlış. “I didn't create the colors. They were always here.”

questions.q: The old man: “I ___ see this color when I was young.”

questions.explain: laugh at someone = birine (alay ederek) gülmek.

questions.q: Sırala: She / painted / a / yellow / sun
questions.explain: Sıfat isimden önce gelir: a yellow sun.

stories.title: Nilo, the Invisible Ghost
pages: Nilo was an [[invisible|görünmez]] ghost. He lived in an old [[lighthouse|deniz feneri]] by the sea. Once, he could laugh, cry and feel everything. But one [[stormy|fırtınalı]] night, the wind [[blew away|uçurup götürdü]] all his feelings. Now he felt nothing at all. Not happy, not sad, just [[empty|boş]].

So Nilo [[went on a journey|yolculuğa çıktı]] to find them. In a busy market, he found Joy. It was hiding in a little girl's laugh as she [[chased|kovaladı]] a red balloon. Nilo touched the laugh, and suddenly he smiled. “One feeling back,” he thought. “Only a few more to go.”

In a hospital, he found Sadness. It was sitting next to an old woman who [[missed|özlüyordu]] her husband. Nilo didn't want it, but he took it [[gently|nazikçe]]. He cried for the first time in years. It hurt, but it was real. Then, on a dark bridge, he found Fear, [[shaking|titreyen]] like a small bird.

Nilo was afraid of Fear, but he held it [[anyway|yine de]]. Now he had Joy, Sadness and Fear, but something was still [[missing|eksik]]. Tired, he went back to the lighthouse. There, a lost kitten was crying in the rain. Nilo [[wrapped|sardı]] it in an old blanket, and a warm feeling [[filled|doldurdu]] his heart. It was Love, the last and the strongest feeling. It had never left him. It was only waiting. That night, for the first time, someone could see Nilo: the little kitten.

questions.q: What happened on the stormy night?
options: The wind blew away all his feelings
questions.explain: The wind blew away all his feelings.

options: In a little girl's laugh at a market
questions.explain: In a busy market… hiding in a little girl's laugh.

questions.q: What happened when Nilo took Sadness?
options: He cried for the first time in years
questions.explain: He cried for the first time in years.

questions.q: Which feeling was the last and the strongest?
questions.explain: It was Love, the last and the strongest feeling.

questions.q: Doğru mu yanlış mı? “Love left Nilo on the stormy night.”
questions.explain: Yanlış. “It had never left him. It was only waiting.”
be afraid of = -den korkmak. “afraid from” yanlış.

questions.q: Sırala: Nilo / went / on / a / journey
questions.explain: go on a journey = yolculuğa çıkmak (geçmiş: went).
